root_cause: Production advanced from 593 to 603 migrations through live recovery work while the repository remained at the earlier ledger. Supabase Preview therefore failed before Edge Function validation with MIGRATIONS_FAILED because remote production versions were absent locally.
prevention: Production supabase_migrations.schema_migrations is the migration identity authority. Reconcile already-applied live migrations into Git under their exact production version/name and exact recorded statements, update migration-history.lock.json to the full production ledger, and never replay the DDL during repository identity reconciliation.
